description: Land Title Settlement Department  -  Sippikulama,  Hambanthotha  D/S Division, Hambantota  District - Cad. Map No.  830111
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Hambantota District. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels, their extent, ownership status, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
